acquisition_note: Inputs are byte-verified public sibling-repository mirrors; the official DrivenData data tab requires login in this environment.

1.description: Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field

2.description: Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects

3.description: Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction

4.description: Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude

5.description: Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction

6.description: Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection

7.description: Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR

8.description: Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)

9.description: Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction

10.description: Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)

11.description: Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change

12.description: Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed

13.description: Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass

14.description: Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field

15.description: Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover

16.description: Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)

17.description: Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface

18.description: Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change

19.description: Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

labels.tif.role: USGS Quaternary + INGENIOUS catalogue, int8, -1 outside the footprint

sample_submission.tif.role: geometry template; 5,167,373-pixel footprint, 0/1 inside, NaN outside

training_features.tif.role: 19 float32 bands; band tags carry the organiser's own band names

current_643cbe.role: current owner-derived SGMC proxy only; not organizer truth

historical_h2b_26d142.role: historical H2-B SGMC proxy instrument; distinct byte version; not organizer truth
